site.title: Generative AI — Cheat Sheets
site.tagline: Four algorithms from my handwritten GenAI-IITM.pdf notes, each turned into a self-contained interactive cheat sheet and an undergraduate-level PDF — plus an essay in the mnemonic medium.
site.footer: Each HTML file is fully self-contained (KaTeX pre-rendered, fonts inlined). Arithmetic and notation follow the source notes; the interactive demos are illustrative.
